QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Challenge! Ghosts and Ghoulies
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Oliver, the guide of Ghostacular Mansion in Funky Station <2>, and enter if you dare.
QuestInfo.1: Take the portal next to Oliver and complete the Ghosts and Ghoulies challenge.
QuestInfo.2: You completed the Ghosts and Ghoulies challenge!

0.msg: I shall guide you through Ghostacular Mansion.

1.msg: This is supposed to be a really thrilling, heart-pounding adventure, right?

2.msg: Yes. Not a single guest has yet escaped the mansion without a harrowing tale of adventure and excitement. But please, calm yourself. It will only further disturb the creatures that await you inside... Shall we?
